pairs.subject: hitl-approval
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:181 The pending set is read by state alone, with no deadline, terminal action or overdue mark. An open packet waits forever and never shows as late, which breaks the golden path's rule that a pending decision expires on a named schedule. A grep of packages/kernel/src/decision, lib/decision and the desk components for expir/deadline/overdue/reap found no packet expiry.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:50 Approval is bound to a version. The commit token folds in the v1 digest, and the kernel refuses the commit when the content moved after the preview. preview() also refuses any packet whose head state is not open (line 217).
app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:74 Every patch, pick, undo, commit and return is written in one kernel transaction. The author record names the operator, the surface and the session uid.

app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:236 A repeat of the same verdict is idempotent and a conflicting one is refused. After the commit, apply is kicked, and the DecidedDesk shows the apply as pending, applied or stuck, with v1's error and a redrive.

app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:182 The rail is built from the kernel's packets plus the Weir piles not opened yet, so it is complete by construction. Write and load errors are toasted (Board.tsx:109). Queue hygiene (expiry) is missing; that gap is recorded under severity-sla-ladder.

app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:222 The consequence shown before a commit is computed from the stored decisions at the head revision, not from what the asker says about itself. A stale preview is shown again (commitFlow.tsx:167).
app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:181 There is no per-source or per-severity deadline and no hold-then-overdue rung. Open packets are immortal, and the rail only sorts by openedAt (PacketRail.tsx:32).
